release_notes:
KLAM 3.7.5 Production Release

Corrected the Church 10% Tithe calculation under Payroll & Compliance so that the automatic monthly tithe is calculated exclusively from the JMD Finance/Giving TITHES category for the selected month. USD tithe transactions are excluded from the calculation.

Corrected Finance Income and Expense transaction editing so that changes made through Edit Selected, including date, account, category, amount, service/vendor and note information, are properly saved to the existing transaction without requiring the transaction to be deleted and re-entered.

Income and Expense edit/save functionality was functionally tested using existing transactions. Edited amounts immediately updated the transaction registers and financial totals, and the test transactions were successfully restored to their original values.

KLAM 3.7.5 completed release certification and is the approved official tested production baseline.
